subject.title: Gateway becomes slow or times out under multi-session / multi-agent load

question: Should this issue remain the broad multi-session Gateway liveness umbrella, or should maintainers split and route the remaining work to narrower canonical issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78861 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66360?
rationale: Current main has meaningful partial fixes, but deciding the durable owner boundary requires maintainer intent across Gateway scheduling, session storage policy, diagnostics, and channel-delivery reliability.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad multi-session Gateway liveness tracker while narrower fixes continue landing underneath it.

options.title: Split To Canonicals
options.body: Close this only after maintainers explicitly move each remaining symptom to narrower canonical issues and preserve the reporter's live evidence links there.

options.title: Sponsor A Reliability Project
options.body: Treat the issue as a larger Gateway reliability project with explicit load-proof acceptance criteria before any closure.

recommendation.title: Keep As Umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad multi-session Gateway liveness tracker while narrower fixes continue landing underneath it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway/session hot-path history and related maintainer closeouts make this the best available routing owner from the evidence trail.
